# Bundled swipe model and English dictionary credits

Model: Destin Moss/youcoded.ai,2026, MIT; pinned SHA941272a7…c46110.
MIT permission/warranty text is bundled as swipe-engine-MIT.txt; copyright and
training-data attribution are retained in MODELS-NOTICE.md and FUTO notice.
No FUTO proprietary model/code is included.

Dictionary: English AOSP LatinIME word list plus FineWeb/Tatoeba counts released
by Destin Moss, f48099755cd1ebeb3f3a9e40f680a683ccc95b2b/language-files-2026-10-23-apostrophes.
Retain LANGUAGE-FILES-NOTICE.md, Apache, ODC-By, Tatoeba notice and full author list.
Derivative generation: tools/swipe/build_english.py. Only English ASCII/apostrophe
identities admitted by the current26-key adapter; nonword flags excluded, case/
frequency/otherflags preserved. This limitation is recorded in english-data-manifest.
No quality-based holdout pruning or private vocabulary is present.

FineWeb is by Hugging Face, derived from Common Crawl under applicable source terms:
https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb
https://commoncrawl.org/terms-of-use
Tatoeba: https://tatoeba.org/en/downloads, CC BY2.0France, full contributor list retained.
AOSP: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/packages/inputmethods/LatinIME,
revision127336e9f29d69607eab55982324b210279ae8c5 (publisher's assets.lock).

The exact AOSP upstream NOTICE (including original copyright notices) is retained
as AOSP-NOTICE.txt, decoded from the publisher's pinned Gitiles base64 artifact.
Generic Apache license terms are not used as a substitute for upstream attribution.
